d:
Welcome to Cyrus Says!
Cyrus Broacha is joined by comedian, actor and improviser Shantanu Anam for another chaotic episode of Cock & Bull on Cyrus Says!
Shantanu opens up about his weight-loss journey from 145 kg to nearly 100 kg, his upcoming improv performances with Rahul Subramanian and Neville Bharucha, and his rather unsuccessful attempt at getting detained during a protest in Mumbai.
